title: probe_results — constructed probe results (produced by Stage 2.5; decision record 000 §2.4 / 013 scheduled discovery)
description: Complete record of every probe request or unexecuted probe candidate. Legacy standalone probes keep recording the construction basis, request, response, success and cleanup state; since 013, scheduled/not_executed candidates may also record audit information on generation, scheduling, material and admission triage.

probe_kind.description: Candidate source type for 013 scheduled discovery. Optional; legacy artifacts without it are still interpreted with the existing method_completion semantics.

execution_mode.description: Probe execution mode. Optional; default/absent is equivalent to the existing standalone. not_executed means only the candidate and the reason it was not executed are recorded.

not_executed_reason.description: Required when execution_mode=not_executed; explains why only the candidate was recorded and no request was sent.

target.description: Probe target. Since 013, canonical_path is optional: before a response-derived URL is canonicalized, only candidate_url is recorded, without pretending to be a stable canonical_path.

candidate_url.description: 013 response-derived or not-yet-canonicalized candidate URL; when present, canonical_path is not required.

operation_id.description: Optional: the operationId derived per D5 if the probe succeeded

original_candidate_path.description: 014H runtime-material original same-origin candidate path; diagnostic only, does not represent canonical admission.

resolved_execution_path.description: 014H path actually executed by the explicit read-safe runtime probe; obtained by aligning with the OAS template prefix.

expected_template_hint.description: Template hint used by 014H path alignment; still subject to the later Phase 5 gate.

construction_basis.description: Construction basis. V1 has only layer one, method_completion (conservative method completion); body_construction is a reserved value for layer two (enhanced request-body construction); 013 scheduled_discovery is used for insertion-based scheduled discovery.

reused_request_ref.description: Reference to the existing request being reused (points to an entry in the session bundle)

anchor_sequence.description: In 'original successful sequence + anchor insertion' scheduling, the sequence of anchor operations executed before this probe is inserted

request.description: The probe request actually sent; may be absent when execution_mode=not_executed.

response.description: The response received; may be absent when execution_mode=not_executed.

success.description: Successful probes are Stage 3 candidates; failed ones are diagnostic only and do not enter the official specification or the dependency graph. May be absent when execution_mode=not_executed.

cleanup.description: Cleanup state (write-probe safety shell and create–use–cleanup). May be absent when execution_mode=not_executed.

required.description: Whether this probe requires a cleanup action

basis.description: Cleanup trust basis (decision record 010 D60). Optional; defaults to per_probe_cleanup. environment_reset = relies on the environment-level reset as the fallback (performed may be false and the probe is still admitted as trusted; the reset at the end of the batch honors it); per_probe_cleanup = per-probe cleanup criterion.

schedule.description: Insertion scheduling record for 013 scheduled discovery; it only records why and where the probe was executed or why it was not scheduled, and does not replace the measured request/response facts.

anchor_entry_id.description: Reference to the same-resource anchor; suggested encoding run_id#entry_index, which later implementations may tighten into a structured reference.

checkpoint_entry_id.description: Checkpoint reference; suggested encoding run_id#entry_index, which later implementations may tighten into a structured reference.

checkpoint_type.description: 013-D checkpoint scheduling source type. cookie_based only records the design slot; it does not mean a full cookie jar has been implemented.

checkpoint_method.description: Recorded request method corresponding to an operation_based checkpoint.

prefix_steps.description: Sequence of operationIds replayed before the probe is inserted.

probe_step.description: Logical step number of the probe after the prefix.

suffix_policy.description: Destructive probes may use skip, meaning the original recorded suffix is not forced to continue after success.

generation_basis.description: Deterministic generation source of a 013-D probe candidate; records why this candidate was generated, not the scheduling/execution result.

source_entry_id.description: Reference to the source entry of the generation; suggested encoding run_id#entry_index.

source_jsonpath.description: Source JSONPath in the response/request body; may be omitted for non-body sources.

source_xpath.description: Source XPath-ish selector in an XML response body; may be omitted for non-XML sources.

source_field.description: Header or structured response field source; may be omitted for non-header/field sources.

source_value.description: Redacted, safety-checked source value used when generating the candidate.

derived_candidate.description: Candidate path / URL / method / graph-edge representation derived deterministically by generation_rule.

material.description: 013 audit record of the request material and of the sources of old values / fresh values.

body_template_source.description: Source of the request-body template for a body-bearing probe; may be a reused_request_ref or an implementation-defined template reference.

value_basis.description: Grading of the source of the values used by this probe; old values may help discover APIs but must not pass for fresh-value grounding; not_applicable means the probe has no request body, no fresh/runtime/literal material and needs no extra material, typically a read-only existence probe.

runtime_secret_bindings.description: Audit record of redacted placeholders in the body template being explicitly replaced from runtime configuration/secrets; plaintext secrets are not recorded.

generated_value_fields.description: Test-value fields generated or mutated from the schema / recorded values / field names; not a fresh value flow.

literal_assumptions.description: Explicit assumptions made when reusing old literals or stable literal values.

producer_probe_id.description: Scheduled POST probe that is the source of the fresh producer bridge.

producer_operation_id.description: operationId that is the source of the fresh producer bridge.

consumer_template.description: Consumer canonical path verified by the fresh producer bridge.

fresh_value_binding.description: Binding record of a fresh value from this run's response replacing the probe's request material during prefix replay.

admission.description: 013 existence evidence and Stage 3 admission/diagnostic triage record. Diagnostics stay in probe_results by default and need not be written to augmented_oas.
